branchName.instructions: Branch names come from the Kaneo card: <PROJECT>-<number>, e.g. VER-35. Cut from develop — that is this repository's default branch, not main — and open the PR against develop. Never revive feat/NEU-* branches.

commitMessage.instructions: Imperative subject under 72 characters, body explains the why rather than restating the diff. One logical change per commit. No .NEU- ids in the subject; the card carries the reference. Never commit local.properties, keystores or credentials.

pullRequest.instructions: Open against develop. Title describes the change, not the ticket number. Body: what changed, why, which tests ran (unit / connected / emulator) with their real output, and what is explicitly unverified. UI changes should say which devices or emulator images were used.
